_comment: Speaker ids used in .dlg files. 'portrait_prefix' picks the art file: portraits/<prefix>_<mood>.png, falling back to portraits/<prefix>.png, and to a labelled placeholder card when neither exists yet.
_player: There is no entry for the player. They type their own name at the start of a run, and content refers to them with the token {player}. Do not add one.

choi.notes: THE FINAL BOSS, not the player. US Immigration Officer at Toronto Pearson preclearance. Korean-American, tall, shaved, black hair going white at the temples. Loud in a room built to carry sound. Refuses everyone, by any of the methods catalogued in assets/text/abuse, and believes he is correcting a misunderstanding rather than doing harm.

ward.notes: Detective. Knows more than he says, says more than he should.

park.notes: Desk sergeant. Runs the shift, and the gossip.
